control.name: CONTROL — invert the noop check (an already-repaired pair churns writes every run)

mutations.name: SEC-1b (login half): the driver-login check is disarmed — any foreign applier, trusted or not, gets re-attested
SEC-1b (cutoff half): the cutoff check is disarmed — the driver's login vouches for a label applied at any time, not only before the #336 legacy-backlog cutoff
SEC-1a: the provenance gate is aggregated across the whole pair instead of checked per label — a half-swap timeline (one half already dispatcher-standing, the other foreign) is not refused
